_comment: Mutation profiles control which Tencent Cloud API actions are permitted.
Switch profiles:  set TENCENT_MCP_PROFILE=<name> in .env and restart the container.
Add a profile:    add a new key below, restart — no code change needed.
label            — human-readable description shown in logs and get_audit_policy.
allowedMutations — array of 'service:Action' strings that are explicitly allowed
beyond readonly actions. Use 'service:*' to allow all actions
for a service, or '*:*' to allow everything (dev only).
Each profile MAY override (omit to use the shared defaults below):
readonlyPrefixes — action name prefixes always allowed as read-only.
denyPrefixes     — action name prefixes always blocked, even if allowlisted.
Singular/plural equivalence is automatic: allowing 'dlc:CreateTask' also
Env-var fine-tuning (applied on top of the active profile, wins over the file):

default.label: Default — DLC SQL execution only (safe baseline)

readonly.label: Read-only — zero mutations, safest, CI/reporting/audit environments
